summary: Lane County lookout 1 mile NE of Lowell, Oregon: 1948 steel tower replaced 1930s crow's nest; dismantled 1979 or removed 1982; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 1948 war-surplus steel tower with a small cab and L-4 ground living quarters (register: 8x8 ft cab; annual report via Rex's page: 7x7 ft cab and 14x14 ft ground house)
facts.status_note: Removed 1982 per the register and firelookout.com; Rex's page says dismantled and salvaged in 1979

staffing.status: tower observer for the last two summers as of June 1957; a 1974 season described; no end-of-staffing date in these sources

facts.agency: Eastern Lane Forest Protective Association (Eastern Lane FPA)

events.note: Lookout tree established around 1935 (Rex's page); the register dates the crow's nest and cabin only to the 1930s
War-surplus steel tower replaced the crow's nest and cabin; sources disagree on tower height (30 vs 35 ft) and cab size
A woman served as tower observer for the Eastern Lane Forest Protective Association for the last two summers (Lebanon Express item on Rex's page)
Tower glass broken out and 15 to 20 windows broken in the living quarters; wood cook stove stolen a week before occupancy and replaced with a gas stove
Rex's page: lookout dismantled and salvaged; conflicts with the 1982 removal date
Register and firelookout.com: tower and living quarters removed

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says a 35-foot tower with an 8x8 cab; the 1948 annual report quoted on Rex's page says 30 feet with a 7x7 cab. Height 9.1 m (30 ft) is kept because it comes from the more specific annual report and matches the brief; the story reports both figures.
Rex's page says dismantled and salvaged in 1979; the register and firelookout.com say removed in 1982. The story gives both and does not choose one.

notes_for_editor: Brief height_m 9.1 (30 ft) agrees with the annual report quoted on Rex's page; the register says 35 ft, so the height is contested. Brief agency 'Eastern Lane FPA' matches the register; Rex's page header reads 'Eastern Lane District, Oregon Department of Forestry'. The brief's removal status is consistent with both dates. No source describes site condition or access today; the web search for current status found nothing. No photos added (the register's photos are unlabelled by content and were not viewed).
